## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the red block with the left arm, switch to the right, and place it on the blue pad.

Task description: Use the left arm to pick up the upright red rectangular block on the left side of the table, hand it to the right arm, then place it on the blue square mat on the right.

Success criteria: The center of the red rectangular block's initially downward-facing end is near the center of the blue mat's top surface, and its bottom end rests on the mat; the right gripper is open and has released the block.

## Execution tips

- The left gripper can grasp opposite sides of the red block around the lower-middle section. Keep the pads clear of the vertical edges and the fingertips above the table, leaving room for the right gripper to contact the upper section.
- Set the opening slightly wider than the width of the selected grasp area. Before closing, confirm that the fingers are on opposite sides rather than merely overlapping in the image without enclosing the red block.
- During the handoff, offset the grippers along the red block's long axis. Release the left gripper only after the right has a secure grasp to avoid gripper collision or loss of support.
- Keep the red block's long axis nearly vertical during placement. Reduce the descent near the mat and release only after the bottom end is supported, reducing the risk of tipping.
